google-tag-manager-mcp-server.description: Google Tag Manager MCP server for GTM API operations. Provides CRUD operations for templates, variables, tags, triggers, versions, and workspace management.

auth.note: On first use, opens browser for Google OAuth. Tokens cached in ~/.mcp-auth/

stape-mcp-server.description: Stape MCP server for server-side GTM container management. Provides analytics and domain management for sGTM.

google-ads-mcp.description: Google Ads MCP server for campaign analysis and GAQL queries. Supports OAuth and service account authentication.

gateway-mcp.description: Gateway MCP for Meta CAPI Gateway and Signals Gateway infrastructure management.

ghl-mcp.description: GoHighLevel MCP server for CRM operations - contacts, opportunities, pipelines, and webhooks.

meta-ads.description: Meta's official hosted Ads MCP server. Campaign, ad set, ad, and creative management; reporting and insights; catalogs; signals and datasets; A/B tests and conversion lift studies; activity logs.

auth.note: On first use the client opens Facebook Login for Business; approve the scoped permissions. No Meta app or token setup required. Programmatic alternative: user access token with business_management, sent as Authorization: Bearer.
